description: This file contains a PHP class 'Forgotten' within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling 'forgot password' functionalities such as displaying forms, processing password reset requests, resetting passwords, and managing user tokens via various methods.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class for handling 'forgot password' workflows including page rendering, confirmation, password reset, and token management in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the forgotten password page with breadcrumbs and layout components unless the user is already logged in, in which case it redirects to the account page.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the forgotten password form submission, generates a password reset token, and redirects or returns JSON response based on success or errors.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Displays the password reset form if the provided token and email are valid, or redirects to login if invalid or already logged in.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Handles password change submissions, validates tokens, enforces password strength rules, updates password, and redirects upon success.
